sourceText: 那就开始吧，直到全部完成。上下文为 Playbook Runtime Memory Consumption 执行方案；本 story 只实现 MVP1 Runtime Pack And Session Consumption。
normalizedOutcome: session_brief 自动消费并显示 bounded non-authoritative memory/playbook runtime pack；active playbook 和 dev-memory 命中可见；candidate inert；freshness digest 可验；M5-M12 不被误称完成。
acceptanceClaim: MVP1 is complete when build and focused smoke prove active appears, candidate does not appear, digest/non-authoritative fields exist, 60-line cap holds, relevant source mutation is stale-relevant, and session_brief renders the pack without claiming gate evidence.
